data.key: Sorcerer Bonus Spell L4 ~ Remove Curse
data.name: Remove Curse
data.description: Remove curse can remove all curses on an object or a creature. If the target is a creature, you must make a caster level check [1d20 + caster level] against the DC of each curse affecting the target. Success means that the curse is removed. Remove curse does not remove the curse from a cursed shield, weapon, or suit of armor, although a successful caster level check enables the creature afflicted with any such cursed item to remove and get rid of it. Remove curse counters and dispels bestow curse.|PRERULE:1,DisplayFullSpell
